deviations.what: The sample is THREE views: a container view whose Page content holds two mvc:XMLViews (view.Linear and view.Branching), each with its own controller. abap2UI5 has no named XMLViews to instantiate, so both wizards are inlined directly into the Page's content, each keeping the visible expression its mvc:XMLView carries ({= ${/selectedShowCase} === 'linear'} / '=== branching'). structural-diff reports mvc:XMLView as missing; every control inside the two views is present. The Branching controller's _findParentView walk exists only to reach across that view boundary and has nothing to do here.

onCurrentStepChangeLinear and onCurrentStepChangeBranching call setCurrentStep on the respective wizard. Wizard.currentStep is an ASSOCIATION and cannot be bound, so both Selects drive the wizard through the framework's whitelisted control_by_id goToStep call. The branching one's try/catch (which toasts the error, resets the Select and re-applies the last path) has no counterpart: goToStep on an unreachable step is a no-op with a UI5 log rather than a thrown exception here.

applyPath reads the picked radio button's TEXT and walks the arrow-separated path calling setNextStep on each step, clearing the last one's. The port keeps the three paths as data and issues the same setNextStep calls through control_by_id (whitelisted), so enableBranching still follows the picked path. discardAndApplyPath's discardProgress and the Select reset are reproduced the same way.

validateProdInfoStep reads the two Inputs imperatively and calls setValidated; the port binds ProductInfoStep.validated and the two value states and recomputes all three in ABAP on the same change wires. The Linear view declares no validated attribute at all, so the step starts VALIDATED here too - that is what lets currentStep="PricingStep" hold on startup. onActivate syncs the Select with the activated step, which the port does by sending each step's id with its activate wire (an added activate attribute on the steps the sample leaves unwired).

The Select drives the Wizard's backgroundDesign through a two-way binding. The property does exist and is base-version - sap.m.Wizard declares backgroundDesign with no @since (Wizard.js:156) and a real public setBackgroundDesign (:685) - so the earlier claim that it is absent from the 1.71 metadata and has no whitelisted setter was wrong on both halves.

The two showcases, the two current-step Selects, the three branching paths and the step-2 validation are unverified in a running system. **e2e-verified 2026-08-25** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_534.mjs).

render_smoke.reason: sap.m.Wizard.setCurrentStep logs Log.error('The given step could not be set as current step.') when the association is applied before the steps aggregation is filled - _isStepReachable does getSteps().indexOf(oStep) and the list is still empty (node_modules/@openui5/sap.m/src/sap/m/Wizard.js:622/831). The sample's own view carries the identical <Wizard currentStep="PricingStep"> with the steps as children, so the log is the SAMPLE's, not the port's; the wizard still opens on the Pricing step once it renders. Verified against the render each run: the skip is honoured only while it still errors, and removing currentStep makes the port render clean.
